hook_line: SUPREME COURT WON'T RESTORE DEPORTATION CASE PAUSE

hook_stat.sub: Emergency order with no public dissent

stats.label: Texas settlement approved, blocking the rule nationwide
Appeals court declined to put the agreement on hold
Cities that sought to defend the Biden-era rule

diaspora_bullets: Indian nationals in removal proceedings lose a pause tool
Pending cases now move forward toward a decision
news_summary: The Supreme Court refused to reinstate immigration judges' power to shelve deportation cases, leaving in place the Trump administration's same-day settlement with Texas that blocked the Biden-era rule nationwide.
payoff: Cases can no longer be paused on this ground, so pending deportation cases move forward toward a decision.
